children: Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.53 billion, up 3.1% from a year earlier, while net income rose 61.5% to $704 million. Diluted earnings per share were $2.35 per Class A unit and $1.55 per exchangeable unit.
Revenue was $2.53B, compared with $2.45B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 3.1%.
Net income was $704M, compared with $436M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 61.5%.
Diluted earnings per share were $2.35 per Class A unit and $1.55 per exchangeable unit, compared with $1.51 and $0.96, respectively, in the prior-year quarter.
Systemwide sales increased 6.2% to $13.0B, comparable sales rose 3.8%, and restaurant count grew 3.0%.
Burger King comparable sales increased 8.3%, while international sales grew 9.0%. Firehouse Subs and Tim Hortons comparable sales each rose 1.5%.
Popeyes comparable sales declined 1.8% in the quarter and 4.5% year to date, weighing on segment results.
International restaurant count grew 5.6%. Royalty revenue benefited from stronger sales and the resumption of Burger King China royalties following the start of a joint venture.
The company continued refranchising acquired Burger King restaurants and plans to seek investors for PLK China and Firehouse Brazil before sunsetting RH.
